title: EAO Focused Training - The European Association for Osseointegration
html:
Day 3 – Programme

8:30 – 10:00 – Soft tissue management around implants in the esthetic area. The suprabony component of the root

10:00 – 10:30 – Break

10:30 – 11:30 – Keratinized tissue height and soft tissue thickness in the prevention and treatment of gingival recession around implants

11:30 – 12:30 – Increase in soft tissue thickness during immediate/delayed implant placement

12:30 – 13:30 – Lunch

13:30 – 15:30 – Hands-on: Coronally Advanced Flap for single/multiple gingival recessions/Mucosal dehiscences

15:30 – 17:30 – Hands-on: Keratinized mucosa augmentation around dental implants


Who benefits from this course?

Dentists looking to specialise 

Master the latest soft tissue management techniques to address complex implant cases.

Clinicians aiming to refine their skills

Gain proficiency in advanced implant dentistry methods through hands-on training with the newest technologies.

Professionals seeking hands-on training

The course allows you to refine your skills and confidently handle complex implant dentistry procedures.

An all-inclusive package

This EAO Focused Training offers a unique opportunity to combine professional development with relaxation. The 3-day programme will be held in Lisbon, Portugal, allowing you to learn advanced techniques whilst taking in the city’s beautiful scenery.

The course fee includes stunning accommodation at VIP Grand Lisboa and full board meals, ensuring a focused and enriching experience.
